newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico spot peso recovers somewhat but ends weaker.
newsitem.headline: Mexico spot peso recovers somewhat but ends weaker.

text.p: Mexico's spot 48-hour peso closed 4.4 centavos weaker on Friday at 7.579/7.584 per dollar after recovering somewhat from steeper declines earlier in the session.
The Mexican currency regained some strength after the bolsa began to rebound from sharp early losses.
The 24-hour peso also shaved some of its early declines to close 5.7 centavos weaker at 7.575/7.58 per dollar.
The 24-hour peso contract opened 11.45 centavos weaker at 7.60/7.6375 per dollar, while the 48-hour contract was 9.75 centavos weaker to 7.60/7.6375 per dollar.
Earlier, the same-day peso closed six centavos weaker at 7.5630/7.5670 per dollar, also better than its day's lows, amid a falling stock market and rising bond yields in the United States.
